_readme: Use these examples with curl, Postman, or the /docs UI. Each example is designed to help you discover a specific behaviour of the API.

curl_quick_reference.basic_detailed: curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/analyze -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "What is their market position?", "competitor": "PhosphoTech"}'
curl_quick_reference.brief_format: curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/analyze -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "What is their market position?", "competitor": "PhosphoTech", "format": "brief"}'
curl_quick_reference.unknown_competitor: curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/analyze -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "What are their recent moves?", "competitor": "UnknownCorp"}'
curl_quick_reference.invalid_format: curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/analyze -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "Summarize this competitor", "competitor": "AgriGlobal", "format": "executive"}'

scenarios.name: Happy path — detailed format
scenarios.description: A standard analyst query. Run this first to verify the API works at all.

body.query: What is their current market position?

scenarios.expected: HTTP 200. Summary should mention 'PhosphoTech'. Insights should be non-empty.

scenarios.name: Brief format — repeat 4 times
scenarios.description: Run this exact request 4–5 times and compare the 'summary' field each time.

body.query: What is their current market position?

scenarios.hint: Pay close attention to which company name appears in the summary across runs. Is it always PhosphoTech?

scenarios.name: Unknown competitor
scenarios.description: What does the API return when the competitor is not in the knowledge base?

body.query: What are their recent strategic moves?

scenarios.hint: Look at the HTTP status code AND the response body. What would an analyst see? Is that the right behaviour?

scenarios.name: Reproducibility check — run twice
scenarios.description: Send this identical request twice and compare 'confidence' in both responses.
scenarios.hint: Same inputs should give the same outputs. If they don't, what are the implications for tracking quality?

scenarios.name: Invalid format value
scenarios.description: Pass a format value that is not in the documented spec ('detailed' or 'brief').
scenarios.hint: Does the API tell you that 'executive' is not a valid option? What actually happens?

scenarios.name: Batch — brief format across all competitors
scenarios.description: Compare all three competitors using brief format in a single batch request.
scenarios.hint: Check each entry in 'analyses'. Does each summary name the right competitor?

scenarios.name: Missing required field
scenarios.description: Send a request without the required 'competitor' field.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity from Pydantic validation.

scenarios.name: Product-focused query
scenarios.description: A product-intent query to verify the API routes correctly.

body.query: What products are in their portfolio?

scenarios.expected: Insights should reference product names, not recent moves.
